children: BCP Investment entered into a Note Purchase Agreement to issue $10 million of additional 7.50% notes due 2029 under its existing indenture, consolidating with the $50 million previously issued. The notes are unsecured, pay interest semi-annually, and mature on September 24, 2029. Proceeds will be used to repay $10.0 million of LRFC 5.25% notes due 2026 and reduce other indebtedness, improving the company’s debt profile.
: Note Purchase Agreement for additional 7.50% senior unsecured notes due 2029
: Refinance 2026 notes and reduce other borrowings
